newsitem.title: INDIA: India Punjab cotton falls on monsoon rain reports.
newsitem.headline: India Punjab cotton falls on monsoon rain reports.

text.p: Punjab cotton suffered a setback at the improved level on Tuesday, dealers said.
"Stockists unloaded Punjab varieties following reports of progress of monsoon in the producing centres," one broker said.
The government's failure to announce fresh export quota prompted sales by some state-owned agencies, he said.
Gujarat varieties however moved in a narrow range and finished on a quiet note.
In the spot deals Punjab saw-ginned fell by 10 rupees to 1,840/1,900 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Bengal-deshi slid by 10 rupees at 1,040/1,090 rupees per maund.
F-414 fell to 2,050/2,110 rupees per maund from 2,100/2,125 rupees. Gujarat varieties remained quiet amid limited activity.
Gujarat Kalyan was steady at 14,200/14,600 rupees per candy (355.56 kg). So was Wagad cotton at 12,900/13,000 rupees and Kala-ginned at 12,500/12,600 rupees per candy.
